prompt: A library your product depends on has saved your team hundreds of hours. What does GitHub Sponsors let you do about that?
explanation: GitHub Sponsors is the platform’s funding rail: sponsor an individual or project once or monthly, and GitHub covers the payment fees so the full amount lands with the maintainer.

options.text: Fund the maintainers with one-time or recurring payments
Buy a support contract with an SLA
Hire the maintainers as contractors automatically
Donate compute credits for their CI
